question: Padma Shri awardee Madhuri Barthwal from _________ is a legendary folk singer. She was the first woman music composer for All India Radio.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttrakhand**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Madhuri Barthwal is associated with the field of Music.
 
• She is** known for her significant contributions to the promotion and preservation of folk music from the Uttarakhand** region in India.
 
• **Madhuri Barthwal has been recognized** for her efforts in keeping the traditional music alive and passing it on to future generations.
 
• Her work includes not only performance but also the documentation and teaching of folk music traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• All India Radio India’s Public Service Broadcaster, the Radio vertical of Prasar Bharati has been serving to inform, educate and entertain its audiences since its inception, living up to its motto – ‘Bahujan Hitaya: Bahujan Sukhaya’.
 
• All India Radio is also known as Akashvani.
 
• The name was changed in the year 1957.
 
 
• That means 'Voice from the Sky', AIR is one of the leading and oldest radio networks in the world.
 
• It is headquartered at Akashvani Bhavan in New Delhi
